name: avatar-imaging-pixinode
description: Spike: render Nitro avatars server-side with @pixi/node (real WebGL, no headless browser).
comment: The renderer is consumed via `yarn link "@nitrots/nitro-renderer"` and Vite aliases (see vite.node.config.mjs), the same as the browser service and Nitro-UI — so pixi.js is NOT a registry dependency here. @pixi/node@8 declares canvas/gl as PEER deps (not auto-installed), so they are listed explicitly below; both are native addons and need the system build libs in the README. cross-fetch and @xmldom/xmldom are shimmed at build time, so they are not installed.
